tools.name: traceforge_get_claim_record
tools.title: Get a signed TraceForge claim record
tools.description: Returns the verifier-signed, artifact-bound record of every claim in an agent's completion report, with verdicts and evidence hashes.

tools.name: traceforge_workspace_digest
tools.title: Digest a received workspace
tools.description: Computes the workspace digest of a local directory with the same algorithm as the TraceForge capture layer, to compare with a record's subject.

tools.name: traceforge_check_claim_record
tools.title: Decide whether to rely on a completion report
tools.description: Verifies the record signature and artifact binding, then returns ACCEPT, REVIEW or REJECT with reasons.
